title: Cloud Security: customer termination
content:
Cloud Security customer termination is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources.

An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge.

For active or suspended contracts, record closure date from the frozen clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time.

Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits.

The on-demand termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under the lifecycle and bank-return fee basis.

If a signed commitment remains unexpired and commitment forgiveness on termination is false, invoice its recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability.

No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible.

Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect.

Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies remaining signed commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains.

A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source event reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable withdraw, close, close suspended action, authoritative system records must establish: The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference, customer request reference, original source event reference.

Withdrawal moves the applied contract to closed; customer termination moves an active or suspended contract to closed.

## Basis Q&A

**What happens to a positive signed termination liability?**

A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source event reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Withdrawal without service

Hypothetical case: the customer withdraws an applied contract. There is no setup, usage or termination charge for that withdrawal.
